name: BENCHMARK - Agente SQL DuckLake - chama TEST - v2.2.31

parameters.query:
SELECT
    b.id AS benchmark_id,
    b.id,
    b.pergunta,
    b.categoria,
    b.intent_esperada,
    b.tabelas_obrigatorias,
    b.filtros_obrigatorios,
    b.deve_conter_sql,
    b.nao_deve_conter_sql,
    b.criterio_semantico,
    b.prioridade,
    b.agent_version,
    b.ativo,
    jsonb_build_object(
        'pergunta', b.pergunta,
        'options', jsonb_build_object(
            'use_cache', false,
            'max_repair_attempts', 2,
            'shadow_mode', false,
            'benchmark_mode', true,
            'benchmark_id', b.id,
            'benchmark_agent_version', b.agent_version,
            'benchmark_target', 'TEST'
        )
    ) AS body
FROM public.ai_ducklake_benchmarks b
WHERE b.ativo = TRUE
  AND b.agent_version = 'v2.2.31-benchmark-historico-cliente'
ORDER BY b.prioridade ASC, b.id ASC;

nodes.name: Code - Montar SQL Insert Benchmark DuckLake

parameters.query:
SELECT
  run_id,
  agent_version,
  COUNT(*) AS total_testes,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passou = TRUE) AS aprovados,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passou = FALSE) AS reprovados,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_teste = 'aprovado') AS aprovados_sem_ressalva,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_teste = 'aprovado_com_ressalva') AS aprovados_com_ressalva,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passou = TRUE)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS percentual_aprovacao,
  MAX(criado_em) AS executado_em
FROM public.ai_ducklake_benchmark_runs
WHERE run_id = '{{ $json.run_id }}'::uuid
GROUP BY run_id, agent_version
ORDER BY executado_em DESC;
